between_the_two_texts: Against kap0-v1-annotiert-md, the same date: 58 of this text's 102 long lines stand in it unchanged and 36 more are its lines revised (Plan/runs/koharenz-protokoll-kapitel-0-v2-md/06-against-v1.txt). It is that text's prose without its apparatus — no rules, no annotation, no movement numbers, no „Schluss / Übergang zu Kap 1“ heading — and the names it lacks were only ever in that apparatus: in v1 too no figure is named in the prose. The formula changes person, „Ich bin“ to „Es ist“; the rest keeps its images
